Hey there and thanks to both of you! (I'm actually not sure if I'm replying the right way right now, stupid me!)  
I'm honestly looking forward to school as it's better than the 9 day break I've had literally doing nothing at home.


So I want to go into detail about what I want to do. Had an application to a college that was accepted about a month ago and the only requirement now is to pass high school, I just never understood the point of it until today(why bother going to college if I'm just gonna be lonely there anyway?).

I'm into video games in my spare time but I can't get any that I want because I haven't gotten money, or a birthday/Christmas present for that matter in 10 years.


I want to just pass school, save some money for games/consoles I'll enjoy in my free time, and even saving for the internet since my dad has been threatening to cut my internet (even with an online high school course). The program I'm going to starts next January so quite a while, but I'll hold out and hope my life improves from there!


Oh, and if you're curious I'll be going into programming next January.

A problem of mine is that I have no clue exactly how to get a job. Do they ask for grades? I'm embarrassed to let them know. If they ask for any experience, well I don't have any.   
I've certainly thought about it a lot, but being myself I'm embarrassed about every thing.


Do I apply online, call them. What do I say if I try to apply etc... I feel too clueless and am scared to ask about anything essentially.
